title: 昭旷亭 Zhaokuang Ting
subtitle: Changchun Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.48 m, eave 3.68 m, ridge 7.18 m above the ground
reduced towards the size drawn on the plan, to stand clear of its neighbours or the water

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 映清斋、鉴园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 玉玲瓏館之南為昭曠亭亭東南為映清齋齋東為鑑園敞宇五楹西嚮北為潄瓊齋其東為師善堂（長春園册）臣等謹案鑑園之後有船塢
evidence.summary: South of 玉玲瓏館: 昭曠亭, then 映清齋; east of it 鑑園, a five-bay range facing west, with 潄瓊齋 and 師善堂, and a boathouse behind.

evidence.title: 昭旷亭
evidence.locator: v4 p.25, under 映清斋; source ref 9-205
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四柱虚亭不设棂，天容寥廓水清泠。适然俯仰得佳会，回绝寻常色与形。
evidence.summary: Poem 昭旷亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 映清斋
evidence.summary: A water garden of 1766 south of 玉玲珑馆: a fan-shaped nine-bay study with water on three sides and curved galleries, 月香水影 an open hall, the five-bay two-storey 晴望楼, 益思堂, 陶嘉书屋, 豁如室 and the double-eaved square 昭旷亭.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 昭旷亭, 1x3 cells.
